translation_notes: the region's single RDF operation, SDO.rangeIncludes, becomes sdo:rangeIncludes in call-argument position; nothing else changes

the draft inserted the 14 @prefix statements INSIDE the parenthesised 'from pylode...query.common import (...)' list; moved above the imports and reduced to the one prefix the region uses. The Python import lists are left untouched

context shims: pylode_model_shim reproduces pylode/profiles/supermodel/model.py verbatim (240 lines, standard library + rdflib only) and pylode_common_shim reproduces query/common.py verbatim apart from its single import line, redirected to the model shim; pyLODE is not installable in the evaluation venv and its package __init__ imports `dominate`. Both are imported identically by the two sides; only the two import lines in the region changed

the driver passes a plain Graph for the 'db' union-graph argument instead of a Dataset: the region only forwards it to get_class -> get_name, which uses it through .objects(), and rdflib's isomorphism helper (used by the harness on every Graph-typed argument) cannot consume the quads a Dataset yields

equivalence is established on the returned list of supermodel Class objects; note that their dataclass __eq__ compares only the iri field, so the comparison certifies which terms sdo:rangeIncludes selected, not the whole object tree

finding: worst ratio of the set -- 1 island for 8 lines and 45 lines of import preamble. The region reads the graph and builds Python objects, and ldpy has nothing to offer a read except a shorter term
